policy.source_of_truth: Each project's own repository and runtime remain authoritative; this central register tracks provenance and closure evidence only.
policy.closure_rule: A finding may be marked PASS only when its linked correction commit and its regression test pass are verified on the final commit. A green CI run on another SHA does not close it.
policy.isolation: Findings are keyed by project_id and front. Dark War REA and Guerra Infinita development share a strategic product line but remain separate research and development fronts, branches, artifacts, and pipelines.
policy.no_authority: This registry does not authorize merge, deploy, publication, deletion, secrets, permissions, DNS, production writes, paid resources, or external communications.

findings.title: Fresh-session activation and autonomy A/B/C are not behaviorally verified
evidence: The repository documents A/B/C as NOT RUN in a genuinely fresh target-client session.
Current structural CI does not prove instruction loading or runtime behavior.

regression_test.test: Run A/B/C in a genuinely new Codex/VS Code session and retain traces, client/version, loaded skill evidence and observed behavior.

closure_gate: Fresh-session A/B/C all pass against a recorded catalog commit.
Record target client and version, exact prompt, observed skill loading and evidence.
No merge or deployment is implied.

findings.title: Live child-agent dispatch, independent QA, locking and recovery remain unverified
evidence: PR #6 run #109 passed the deterministic planner and orchestration regression on the current HEAD.
The planner selects READY tasks but does not spawn agents; D1-D3 remain NOT RUN in the target runtime.

regression_test.test: Execute D1-D3 with observable child-agent IDs, two independent tasks, independent QA, conflict/lock behavior, cancellation/recovery and approval boundaries.

closure_gate: At least two real child-agent dispatches are observable with distinct task IDs.
Independent QA verifies results; resource conflicts are serialized or rejected.
Cancellation/recovery and Owner approval gates pass in the actual target client.

findings.title: Public product packaging and license decisions remain open
evidence: The inspected branch has a readiness matrix but no verified license decision, distribution model, quickstart, contribution policy or release process.
License selection is a maintainer decision and must not be inferred.

regression_test.test: Re-run the documented readiness checklist after the maintainer explicitly decides product repository strategy and license.

closure_gate: Owner explicitly decides repository/distribution strategy and license.
Required community, security, onboarding and release documents are reviewed.
External publication remains separately gated.

findings.title: Firebase ID-token verification and legacy UID spoofing protection need final independent validation
evidence: Issue #21 remains open and defines token verification, fail-closed configuration and legacy route hardening.
PR #22 exists on branch fix/firebase-id-token-validation; current behavior must be checked against its exact HEAD and test runs.

regression_test.test: Integration tests for missing, malformed, expired, wrong-project and valid ID tokens, plus UID spoofing on legacy and v1 endpoints.

closure_gate: All token and spoofing regressions pass on the final correction commit.
Independent review confirms trusted identity is derived only from verified claims.
Hosted fail-closed configuration is verified without exposing secrets.

findings.title: PostgreSQL/Supabase runtime authentication failure 28P01 is unresolved
evidence: Issue #44 records a historical 28P01 password-authentication failure and a Render deploy failure on 2026-10-16.
The issue explicitly requires read-only service/config inspection and isolated credential validation; secret values must not be printed or changed.

regression_test.test: Isolated connection, read/write, restart persistence and concurrency checks against synthetic/test data only.

closure_gate: Current Render service branch and non-secret connection mode are verified read-only.
Isolated credentials and database connectivity pass without exposing or changing secrets.
Restart persistence and concurrency tests pass against test data.

findings.title: Android APK pipeline passes but physical Galaxy S21 acceptance is not run
evidence: PR #46 Android APK build run #49 completed successfully and produced a non-empty unsigned debug APK artifact.

regression_test.test: Install the exact artifact on Galaxy S21 and verify login, touch navigation, game-state persistence, API recovery and back navigation.

closure_gate: APK artifact SHA and source commit are recorded.
Physical Galaxy S21 installation and acceptance tests pass.
No Play Store publication or signing-secret change is implied.

findings.title: Hosted API base URL and CSP have CI coverage but live hosted flow remains unverified
evidence: PR #42 API configuration tests and Backend Integration workflows passed on its recorded HEAD.

regression_test.test: Hosted build must not default to localhost; verify login, expedition status, start/collect and reload against the confirmed HTTPS API origin.

findings.title: Authenticated expedition synchronization and multi-player isolation remain unverified
evidence: Issue #12 records partial client/server synchronization and requires authenticated reload/recovery and two-player isolation.
Prior CI evidence covers local/offline persistence and backend idempotency but does not prove the complete authenticated client-server flow.

regression_test.test: Authenticated start/reload/collect, lost-response retry, persistent receipt, no duplicate rewards, and two-user isolation.

closure_gate: Authenticated client/server lifecycle passes end-to-end.
Retries and restarts preserve a single receipt and balance.
Two-user tests prove no cross-player state leakage.

findings.title: Vehicle chip slots, presets, resonance and source-derived odds are incomplete

regression_test.test: Deterministic equip/unequip, preset switch, resonance, duplicate-instance rejection, missing-chip handling and save/reopen.

closure_gate: Screenshot-derived values are transcribed with source filenames and no invented odds.

findings.title: Custom family-55 Lua header decoder remains blocked

source.reference: verified REA continuity note dated 2026-11-11; local artifacts not re-read in this turn

evidence: Prior recorded observation: Lua 5.4.6 backup decoder expects header bytes 0x03 0x54, while family-55 game files use custom 0xA8 0x55.
The standard Lua 5.5.1 decoder rejected the custom header; no semantic opcode claims are authorized from this structural mismatch.

regression_test.test: Hypothesis-driven header/parser fixtures with byte-level provenance and structural round-trip checks; no broad bundle rescan.

closure_gate: Current source files and exact tool versions are re-verified.
Custom format handling is proven on isolated fixtures and existing mappings.
No original bundle is modified and no unsupported semantic claim is made.

findings.title: LuaTxt versus LuaTxt_55 manifest crosswalk is pending
evidence: The previously selected safe next step was a read-only manifest cross-reference using existing mappings.
No broad rescan of the 4,656 bundles is justified by current evidence.

regression_test.test: Compare paired manifest entries and record path, bundle, payload hash, header family and mapping provenance without extracting all bundles.

closure_gate: Crosswalk output is reproducible and references existing manifest/mapping IDs.
Unmapped records remain explicit; no semantic interpretation is inferred from filenames alone.
